item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Simple lighting changes could save turtle hatchlings on Anna Maria Island
item.description: 55 baby sea turtles died after crawling toward lights instead of the ocean. Anna Maria Island conservation group volunteers say simple lighting changes could prevent more deaths.
